integrity: Proved using planar strip slicing, dominated convergence, and a marked polar change of variables followed by Scheffe lemma; checker provides numerical corroboration only.
scientific_limitations: First-order small-determinant asymptotic for planar convex bodies with interior anchor; not a three-random-vertex, boundary-anchor or high-dimensional statement. No quantitative rate. Historical priority provisional.
title: Radial symmetry defect and marked near-collinearity for anchored random triangles
